svg.title: Riju receives a public, paid and time-limited transition extension.
svg.desc: Ila records the reason, pay period and review date in the red ledger. Riju receives his unchanged temporary badge with an extension strip while Vale and Cecil verify that it is a bounded need, not a guaranteed job.
